# Chromora

> Chromora is a free suite of color tools for UI designers and developers: accessible palette generation, WCAG contrast checking, image palette extraction, multi-space color conversion, and CSS/Tailwind design token export. All tools run entirely in the browser; no account or credit card required.

## Tools

- [Color Picker & Explorer](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-picker)
- [Interactive Color Wheel](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-wheel)
- [Color Palette Generator](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-palette-generator)
- [AI Palette Generator](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/ai-palette-generator)
- [Image Color Extractor](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/image-color-extractor)
- [WCAG Contrast Checker](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/wcag-contrast-checker)
- [CSS Gradient Studio](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/gradient-generator)
- [Multi-Way Color Converter](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-converter)
- [Color Shades & Tints Generator](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-shades-generator)
- [Color Mixer](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-mixer)
- [Color Blindness Simulator](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/color-blindness-simulator)
- [Random Color Generator](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/random-color-generator)
- [Pantone & RAL Converter](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/pantone-color-converter)
- [Favicon & App Icon Generator](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/favicon-generator)
- [Live Design Preview](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/design-preview)
- [Named Colors Directory](https://chromoraflow.vercel.app/colors)
